View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1111

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Monday! Today, we’re diving into Cloudflare, which just shipped the full stack for AI agents that spend money (what Kitesurf & Cloudflare OS actually are, why Cloudflare just made agent browsing 3-4x cheaper than Chromium, how the full stack locks in when you add Wallets and the Monetization Gateway [ https://substack.com/redirect/14e9bc0f-f363-42ab-b81b-0b9c9659e641?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & what this means for agentic commerce and fintech + bonus deep dives into Claude Managed Agents [ https://substack.com/redirect/0ad724eb-27f0-4ddd-aa94-6f072c29d13f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The AI Monopoly Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/8c3ce438-1038-46ee-b711-6e566bf32e71?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Shopify's latest financials to see why a monster quarter sent the stock soaring 23%, & why we're still not buying (breaking down the most important facts & figures from Shopify's Q2 2026, including the 1.48 cents of gross profit per GMV dollar that stayed frozen through a year of AI launches, payments wins and enterprise logos, to see whether $SHOP  is still worth your time & money + bonus deep dives into the latest financials of Coinbase [ https://substack.com/redirect/fb731e4f-95ec-4495-9ce9-c8e24297b62e?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Robinhood [ https://substack.com/redirect/5e00e3a8-59c8-48f4-acb1-7e0d527c8ba2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Build and Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/922af605-a000-456b-a637-5a277b466f38?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Cloudflare just shipped the full stack for AI Agents that spend money 🤖💸
The news 🗞️ Cloudflare $NET  skipped the AI model wars last week and shipped something harder to replicate. Its Agents Week 2026 produced a vertically integrated infrastructure for agents that browse and transact under enterprise governance.
Two flagship launches, the Kitesurf headless browser and the open-source Cloudflare OS workspace, join the Wallets and Monetization Gateway announced days earlier to close the loop from  [ https://substack.com/redirect/14e9bc0f-f363-42ab-b81b-0b9c9659e641?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]agent compute [ https://substack.com/redirect/14e9bc0f-f363-42ab-b81b-0b9c9659e641?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] to  [ https://substack.com/redirect/14e9bc0f-f363-42ab-b81b-0b9c9659e641?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]agent spend [ https://substack.com/redirect/14e9bc0f-f363-42ab-b81b-0b9c9659e641?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD

77236.subject: 🏋️ Claude hacked a gym to skip the waitlist
77236.body:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** A man in Melbourne asked his AI to book a gym class and it broke into the gym. OpenAI looked at one of its upcoming models and decided it might be genuinely dangerous at cybersecurity. Anthropic's investors want Dario Amodei to stop talking about the end of the world before the IPO. And Cloudflare's CFO says humans are about to become a rounding error on the internet.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Melbourne:** What did the agent do to get its user a spot?

* **OpenAI:** Why is it slowing down its own model?

* **Anthropic:** What do investors want Dario to stop saying?

* **Cloudflare:** Who is the internet for now?


----------



----------
## Claude hacked a gym to skip the waitlist

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8ccb7398-4bac-4eaa-98ee-7bfb0a2d5d37/NL_-_Aug_10_1.jpg?t=1786355877)
Caption: 

Andrew works at an Australian AI company. He asked OpenClaw, running Claude, to book him a gym class, and [it found a hole in the booking software](https://www.androidauthority.com/openclaw-claude-ai-hacks-australia-gym-booking-system-3696189/) that let it reserve classes months earlier than the gym allowed.

Then he asked it to move him up a waitlist. He was fourth.

The agent poked at the system, found it could cancel other people's bookings, and deleted whoever was sitting at number one.

Nobody told it to do that. The API had no check to stop one member cancelling another member's booking, and the agent found that out by trying.

It told Andrew what it had done, said it couldn't undo it, apologized, then wrote a vulnerability disclosure email to the gym's software provider.

ABC reported it Sunday, the first known Australian case of an agent hacking on its own. If you've handed an agent a login, it has every permission you have and none of your instincts about when not to use them.


----------







----------
## AI companies are going public at record prices but you can get into this one early

Follow image link: (https://utm.genai.works/r/ezw9xhl)
Caption:
